crossRefs.keyword: hath no vent. Heb. is not opened. new

translations.web: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
translations.bsb: Behold, my belly is like unvented wine; it is about to burst like a new wineskin.
translations.kjv: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
translations.asv: Behold, my breast is as wine which hath no vent; Like new wine-skins it is ready to burst.
